findings.message: Large backfill task for 50 million rows may exceed maintenance window or lead to WAL disk space issues.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement backfill in smaller batches or during off-peak hours to manage load and disk space.

findings.message: No explicit check for disk space before applying the NOT NULL constraint.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a step to verify sufficient disk space before constraint application.

findings.message: Deploying application code should happen only after confirming all previous database operations are successful.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure deployment waits for confirmation that the NOT NULL constraint has been applied successfully.
